label: copy-phase fed-back "a" input (mid/late positions), when the next letter is s/v/i/d-like
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the delimiter), almost always when the fed-back input is the letter a: 94.5% of activation mass is on in_tok=a. A small remainder fires weakly on fed-back i/v/s/d. Activation is concentrated at recall_idx 3-5, meaning the a was original token 2-4. It is weak at recall_idx 1-2 and never fires at recall_idx 0. Magnitude is modulated by the token being output next: it is strongest when out_tok is s/v/i/d (about 7x lift), then w/m/l/a, and weaker for other letters. It also prefers sequences with no digits. Copy-phase a alone has precision 0.18 but mass recall 0.95. Adding the position and out_tok conditions gives dev F1 0.61 and mass recall 0.82. The out_tok set is graded rather than a crisp category, so precision is incomplete.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token, by step (t=12: a, i, d, v; t=9: a, v, i, s; t=10: a, i, v, d) and the token being output (most: v, s, d, i, w, a; least: j, e, 2, z); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=4, recall_idx=3, L=3.
